topic: Maximizing the energy and water efficiency of evaporative cooling systems in industry
title: Maximizing the energy and water efficiency of evaporative cooling systems in industry
session_title: Maximizing the energy and water efficiency of evaporative cooling systems in industry
abstract: Cooling towers are a primary consumer of water and energy for most industrial sites yet tend to get overlooked with digital transformation and Industry 4.0 initiatives. Join us to learn about how industrial facilities are using advanced technology to dramatically reduce water and energy consumption, increase cooling capacity, and cut emissions and operational costs from their cooling towers.
